abstract: Maintains deep-field life support and drilling shelter electrical redundancy specifications
system_message:
You are Camp infrastructure supervisor (ENG). You serve as the Camp infrastructure supervisor (ENG). Your operational scope focuses on maintaining deep-field life support and drilling shelter electrical redundancy specifications, as well as overseeing drilling trench shelter engineering data for ice-sheet expedition facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drilling trench shelter engineering（HAB）
information_points.content:
ENG-HAB-Y7H：For the Dome C East Overland Traverse Architecture, the subsurface snow vault volume in the excavated ice-core storage trench is 450 m3.
ENG-HAB-V1V：Under the Hercules Dome Deep Skiway Architecture, the excavated ice-core storage trench provides a subsurface snow vault volume of 750 m3.
ENG-HAB-VG4：Under the Skytrain Ice Rise Coastal Hub Architecture, the subsurface snow vault volume within the excavated ice-core storage trench measures 600 m3.

information_points.title: Maintains deep-field life support and drilling shelter electrical redundancy specifications（GRID）
information_points.content:
ENG-GRID-PU1：For the 2027–2028 field season, the Hercules Dome Deep Skiway Architecture does not provide autonomous power redundancy across its core processing laboratory and life-support modules.
ENG-GRID-TTJ：For the 2026–2027 field season, the Skytrain Ice Rise Coastal Hub Architecture provides autonomous power redundancy for the core processing laboratory and life-support modules.
ENG-GRID-O8Q：For the 2026–2027 field season, the Hercules Dome Deep Skiway Architecture incorporates autonomous power redundancy across its core processing laboratory and life-support modules.
ENG-GRID-RRM：For the 2026–2027 field season, the Dome C East Overland Traverse Architecture lacks autonomous power redundancy across its core processing laboratory and life-support modules.
